notes.title: Version 1.2a Online!
notes.content:
[h1]What is new?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the first part of the story with our new ingame intro (there will be some changes to the video later), the quest line ends after Brad show you the camp.
[*]Added the first quest to the game. (We werent able to offer more quests to this first update of 1.2, we offer very many quests with the next small releases of 1.2, the next update is focused on quests).
[*]Added Dialogues to the game (Voices may not perfect atm, if some players wants to speak some characters in the game it would be very great, post in the forum please, we will contact you. It isnt easy for us to give our voice for the NPCs cause our Team is from Germany, at later stages of the game we will contact some language localization companys for that).
[*]Added Camps of some NPC colonists (not complete in this release).
[*]Fixed a blueprint save problem to online servers.
[*]Fixed a problem where some players cant control the ship with their mouse.
[*]More decorative stuff added.
[*]A new Button added to the create server menu where you can erase your quest progress.
[*]Various small bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Version 1.1a is here!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that we’ve just finished version 1.1a of SSC. 

[h1]The features of the latest update are:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Space!
[*]Spaceships: Just one for testing, but will be expanded with the upcoming small updates.
[*]Moon and other planets: Currently 2 planets and 1 moon, not quite finished yet.
[*]Breathing: You need oxygen in space or in certain atmospheres.
[*]Suit Batteries: For temperature regulation of your spacesuit.
[*]Generators: For generating power or oxygen.
[*]New places to discover.
[*]Additional resources: For harvesting (Some of the old ones will be replaced).
[*]Huge performance improvements.
[*]Context-sensitive control instructions.
[*]A lot of bug fixes. (Please check for AI Bugs on online Servers).
[*]Swimming.
[*]Welder for harvesting.
[*]Enhanced graphics.
[*]New blueprints to find (for new crafting knowledge).
[*]New crafting recipes
[*]More building parts.
[/list]

With the next small updates we will populate the world with more AI.

The Server Version will be available in 2 hours here: http://unexevo.de/Downloads/SSCServer1_1a.rar  (3 am CET).

Lastly, we have talked to Valve about reducing the price, and have been told it is not possible until two months after launch.
We weren’t aware of this until now, but we will continue to give anyone an extra copy if they buy the game before the price drop (notify us in the forum).
